name: Quick search (⌘K)

name: Callout boxes

name: Card reference

description: Filter chips above twelve month tiles, shown or hidden live by data-category.

name: Theme switcher
description: Segmented System/Light/Dark control that restyles only the sample card below.

name: “Was this helpful?”
description: Small help-page footer feedback card that swaps to a thank-you state on vote.
